mechanisms.condition: the barrier must not cut the model endpoint. It DOES cut a host-local relay: NETNS_RELAY_HTTP=000 while the host sees 200 (evidence/02_host_loopback_cut.log). The relay must therefore be reachable from inside the barrier (sibling container) or the lane cannot run closed on this host.

sharp_edges: SimpleLoop's closure is not a property of SimpleLoop: it is inherited. It must be recorded per run (which CLI, which sandbox mode, which web-search setting) or A1 will compare substrates with different access policies -- exactly what plan:591-603 forbids.
The positive control must use the SAME command text as the negative case; a probe that only ever shows failure cannot distinguish a sandbox from broken networking.
